deploy-bot: [AUTO-ROLLBACK] Release 3.9.4 -> rolling back to 3.9.3. Trigger: p95 latency > 1000ms (4m) + errors > 2.5%. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/rollback.

sam: Noted. Canary shows the spike is only on eu-west nodes.

aneeza: I see a config flag flip in 3.9.4 that enables aggressive batching. Could be oversaturating some GPUs.

ops-oncall: Hold auto-rollback for 3 minutes while we confirm. `deployctl rollback hold --id=3.9.4-auto --reason=triage`

deploy-bot: Auto-rollback paused. Waiting 3m for manual decision.

sam: If batching is the cause, prefer manual promote to 3.9.3 and pin eu-dedicated pools to prevent a re-roll: `redwoodctl pin --pool=eu-dedicated --version=3.9.3`

aneeza: Agreed. I'll prepare a quick hotfix branch to revert the batching flag, but promote first.

ops-oncall: Promoting 3.9.3 now: `deployctl promote --service=inference-api --to-version=3.9.3 --force --wait`

deploy-bot: Promote started. Rolling traffic back to 3.9.3.

sam: p95 dropping, errors falling. Pin applied.

ops-oncall: Promote complete. Health checks green. I'll draft the customer blurb and add a postmortem stub.

sre-rotation-bot: Reminder: handover in 25m. Include the rollback and INF-1491.
